verdict.rationale: Package-manager installation is a fair question for a desktop LLM runtime like Jan, but the evidence pack never mentions a package manager (Homebrew, winget, apt, npm, pip, etc.). The only install-related item (jan-gh-7) describes a build-from-source script that installs dependencies and launches the app. That is a different capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
